**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent) — redline validated and submitted.**

- **Investigation:** A document-wide search for "insurance" returned zero hits, and a full read of the general/miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13–30, bundled under sec-12 "INDEMNITY") confirmed no coverage requirement anywhere in the agreement.
- **Direction check:** TrueLink is the vendor — it hosts our web site, holds Client Content and transmits customer credit data through the Interface (and its liability for hosting/support is capped at 12 months' fees under p0077), so uninsured exposure sits squarely with us. This is a vendor-side obligation, not one that benefits TrueLink.
- **Classification:** A hosting vendor that processes personal data with no insurance at all is walk-away territory under the rule, so this is a "missing" finding rather than a drafting nit.
- **Redline:** New Section 31 inserted after Force Majeure (p0097), immediately before the signature block, at the preferred position: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O including tech E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request, surviving one year post-term. The comment offers the fallback limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) to speed negotiation.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the survival clause (p0090) refers to "Sections 1 and 5 through 30" and should be conformed to include the new section — a cross-reference cleanup rather than a separate deviation.
